entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: A substate of 5GMM-REGISTERED state entered when the UE selects a cell known not to provide normal service.

entities.name: Cell cannot provide normal service
entities.description: Condition where the selected cell is known not to be able to provide normal service to the UE.

relations.description: The condition that the selected cell cannot provide normal service leads to the UE entering the 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE substate.
